hooks.message: BLOCKED: Bulk extension removal across all servers is not permitted. Specify individual servers explicitly to remove extensions.
BLOCKED: Deleting Arc server resources removes them from Azure management permanently. Use 'azcmagent disconnect' on the server instead to cleanly unregister.
WARNING: Run Command executes scripts remotely on the target server. Review the script content carefully before proceeding.
WARNING: Installing updates may require a server reboot and could cause service interruption. Verify the maintenance window and reboot setting before proceeding.
WARNING: This operation targets servers across multiple subscriptions. Confirm the scope is intentional.
WARNING: This operation targets servers tagged as production. Confirm this is intentional and that change management procedures have been followed.
SUGGESTION: This query lists all servers without a filter. Consider adding a resource group, OS type, status, or tag filter to narrow the scope.
SUGGESTION: Before applying updates or rebooting servers, verify the maintenance window schedule and confirm the change has been approved.
SUGGESTION: This operation targets multiple servers. Consider running it on a single test server first to verify the outcome before fleet-wide execution.
